name: CSO: P-code the places
description: Every hour: a CSO place given as a pin (the generic form) gets the P-codes of the admin areas it falls in, from the Humanitarian Geocoder; its formula then links the area. Workflow F.
instructions: Rules only: the geocoding is code (agents/tools.py, geocode).

routes.name: pcoded
routes.description: The geocoder found its areas: their P-codes are written.

routes.name: outside
routes.description: The pin is outside the country's boundaries: flagged for the coordinators.

routes.name: try_again
routes.description: The geocoder could not be reached: still pending, tried again next hour.
